questions.question: METICULOUS most closely means:
questions.explanation: Meticulous means extremely careful and precise in detail. Precise is the closest synonym.
steps: 1. Define meticulous: very careful, attentive to detail.
2. Evaluate each choice: Quick (opposite), Careless (opposite), Precise (accurate), Suspicious (unrelated).

questions.question: AMBIGUOUS most closely means:
questions.explanation: Ambiguous means having more than one meaning or unclear. Unclear is the closest synonym.
steps: 1. Define ambiguous: open to more than one interpretation.

questions.question: BENEVOLENT most closely means:
questions.explanation: Benevolent means showing kindness and generosity. Kind is the closest synonym.
